fusions.name: Flushing Blast
fusions.desc: Fires a scatter of feathered shot in a cone 4 tiles long, dealing 9 damage to everything in it and stunning each for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Last Report
fusions.desc: Usable only on a target at or below 25% health. Fires a bolt into the first enemy it meets for 16 damage.

fusions.name: Sighted In
fusions.desc: Your critical hit chance rises by 25% for 10 seconds. You move 15% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Echoing Shot
fusions.desc: Each time you kill something, a second shot flies to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles and deals 6 lightning damage. Once every 5 seconds.
